resources.string: Expand your snippet triggers while typing with any keyboard.

Lets Trexpanda expand your snippet triggers (like ;addr) while you type with any keyboard, such as Gboard. It only looks at the text field you are typing in, never password fields, and only to replace a trigger with your snippet. Nothing you type is stored, logged or sent anywhere.
📎 %1$s copied. If it didn\'t attach, long-press the box and tap Paste.
